metadata.description: Permutation test, stratified DL meta-analysis, head-final correlation, VSO LOO sensitivity, and prediction scorecard

examples.output: {"description": ">=70% treebanks with residualized LLF d > 0.2", "prediction": "proportion >= 0.70", "actual_value": "0.314", "evidence": "Only 31.4% of treebanks show d > 0.2, far below the 70% threshold", "verdict": "FAILED"}

{"description": "Residualized effect size (|d|) increases monotonically with alpha", "prediction": "|median_d| strictly increases with alpha", "actual_value": "{\"1.0\": -0.0327, \"1.2\": -0.0214, \"1.5\": -0.0088, \"2.0\": -0.0071, \"3.0\": 0.0207}", "evidence": "Residualized |median_d| by alpha: [0.0327, 0.0214, 0.0088, 0.0071, 0.0207]; monotonic increase in magnitude: False. Effects hover near zero at all alphas, no amplification pattern.", "verdict": "FAILED"}

{"description": "alpha=1.0 shows no significant effect (negative control)", "prediction": "alpha=1.0 median_d ~ 0 and prop_sig < 0.10", "actual_value": "median_d=-0.033, mean_d=-0.085, prop_sig=0.570", "evidence": "Residualized d=-0.033 is near zero, but prop_sig=0.570 shows many treebanks still reach significance", "verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE"}

{"description": "max(IMB) R^2 < 0.90 from DD (temporal overlap provides novelty)", "prediction": "R^2 < 0.90", "actual_value": "R^2 = 0.939", "evidence": "R^2 = 0.939 > 0.90; temporal overlap IS largely predictable from dependency distance", "verdict": "FAILED"}

{"description": "Residualized max(IMB) provides incremental predictive power p < 0.01", "prediction": "Residualized max(IMB) prop_significant > 0.50 with p < 0.01", "actual_value": "prop_significant = 0.616", "evidence": "Residualized max(IMB) shows prop_significant = 0.616 per-treebank, but no joint model test is available", "verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE"}

{"description": "Spoken > written LLF in >= 60% of register pairs", "prediction": "proportion >= 0.60", "actual_value": "3/6 = 0.500", "evidence": "Only 3 of 6 spoken-written pairs show spoken > written LLF (50%), below 60% threshold", "verdict": "FAILED"}

{"description": "Case-richness negatively associated with LLF effect", "prediction": "Significant negative correlation r < -0.20", "actual_value": "r = -0.047, p = 0.74", "evidence": "Correlation between case richness and LLF effect is r = -0.047 (p = 0.74), effectively null", "verdict": "FAILED"}

{"description": "Disconfirmation: residualized LLF d < 0.1 in majority (overall negligible)", "prediction": "Overall median |d| < 0.1", "actual_value": "median_d = -0.0636 (|d| = 0.0636)", "evidence": "Overall median d = -0.0636 (|d| < 0.1), but typological split shows VSO d = 1.039, SOV d = -0.546", "verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE"}

{"description": "Disconfirmation: effect size does NOT increase with alpha", "prediction": "Residualized |d| does not increase monotonically with alpha", "actual_value": "monotonic |d| increase: False; |d| values: [0.0327, 0.0214, 0.0088, 0.0071, 0.0207]", "evidence": "Residualized |median_d| goes from 0.033 to 0.021; not monotonically increasing \u2014 disconfirmation criterion IS met", "verdict": "CONFIRMED"}

{"description": "Disconfirmation: max(IMB) R^2 > 0.90 from DD (metric is redundant)", "prediction": "R^2 > 0.90", "actual_value": "R^2 = 0.939", "evidence": "R^2 = 0.939 > 0.90 confirms disconfirmation: temporal overlap is largely redundant with DD", "verdict": "CONFIRMED"}
